cards.name: Lara Croft
cards.scene: Pérou. Elle prend appui à l'entrée d'une vallée oubliée et découvre ce qui l'attend.
cards.desc: Pérou. Elle prend appui à l'entrée d'une vallée oubliée et découvre ce qui l'attend.
cards.detail: TOMB RAIDER (1996), PERU / LOST VALLEY. Lara in her iconic fully opaque turquoise sleeveless tank top, practical brown shorts, leather brown backpack with two straps and twin holsters, fingerless dark gloves and rugged calf boots, hair tied back in a compact classic swept-back ponytail (not a massive sculpted mane). A moment of discovery: she has one boot on a mossy stone step, weight on rear leg, slightly forward leaning body in a THREE QUARTER view facing RIGHT. Her left hand rests visibly on a broad weathered lintel beside her, right hand holds ONE classic pistol low safely pointed toward ground away from her own leg; other pistol is holstered. Her eyes and slight raised brow show wonder becoming alertness as she looks into open valley on right. Frame complete head to boots, head around upper quarter, figure fills about 75% height, no extreme foreshortening. Broad green forest canopy and ONE pale waterfall beyond the doorway, muted deep teal stone and warm shaft of afternoon light on her cheek. No dinosaur necessary, no excessive carved motifs, no whole temple complex. Black leather, turquoise shirt and warm skin balanced in Kalistar painted texture. One head, two arms and exactly two coherent hands. Emotion and weight, not a catalogue pose.
cards.title: Le seuil de la vallée perdue
cards.costume: Débardeur turquoise, short brun, sac de cuir et queue de cheval.
cards.weapon: Deux pistolets, dont un en main.

cards.detail: TOMB RAIDER II, VENICE. She aims ONE pistol at an unseen threat off LEFT, elbow slightly bent anatomically correct; her other hand carries the second pistol low beside right hip with muzzle safely down/out. Both arms readable, no crossed overlapping impossible grip. Full body with room for boots. Face is confident and sharply alert with just a hint of amused defiance, not snarling. cards.detail: TOMB RAIDER III, NEVADA DESERT. Adult Lara in official-style NEVADA outfit: blue-gray sleeveless opaque cropped athletic top, green/brown camouflage long cargo trousers, brown ankle combat boots, brown backpack and paired thigh holsters, long chestnut braid. She is CROUCHING with ONE knee on a broad flat reddish sandstone ledge, the other foot planted close under her; side view facing RIGHT, torso slightly raised and head turned three-quarter toward viewer as she listens behind her. One hand holds a compact pair of binoculars lowered in front of her chest after scouting, other hand braces on the stone beside her. Both pistols remain holstered. Slim athletic natural proportions, both knees and feet fully comprehensible, hands separated not fused into equipment. Face tense, cautious, focused. Background has only one broad desert canyon plane and a distant low security fence line under pale cool dawn, a tiny isolated base light permissible, NO large military installation/jet/UFO, not a sandstorm. Character dominates 80%height with quiet space above braid. Ochre sandstone, sage trousers, muted steel-blue shirt, blue-cool shade on face contrasted with thin sunrise rim. Kalistar mature hand-painted material quality, never military photoreal concept art.

cards.detail: TOMB RAIDER IV THE LAST REVELATION, EGYPT. ADULT Lara (NOT her childhood prologue) in turquoise sleeveless opaque fitted top, brown practical shorts, brown backpack, fingerless gloves, twin holstered pistols, brown calf boots and long chestnut braid. Waist-to-boot including full head and upper legs, slightly pulled-back seated/reaching composition: she kneels in three-quarter view LEFT at a low single Egyptian stone altar; torso upright, one arm raises a warm red flare to shoulder height, OTHER hand holds a small ankh-like gold amulet just above altar, delicately by its sturdy top loop. Her eyes study the object with genuine concern and moral doubt, lips pressed and eyebrows slightly furrowed. Hands anatomically readable, five fingers and no extra arms. No gigantic weapons, no skulls or gore, no garment blowing without wind. One broad weathered sandstone wall and ONE large stylized ancient relief behind her, faint turquoise reflected pool-light below, flare amber-red bouncing from amulet onto face, very few tiny sparks. No thousands of hieroglyphs, no pyramid panorama, no crowded treasure pile. Quiet ominous chamber, attention on Lara and the decision, same painterly Kalistar grain and restrained accents as references.
